summary: In-place right shift of a 3-limb big integer a1 by a2 bits (a2 = whole-word shift v8 * 32 + bit shift v3). First pass walks the 3 limbs ascending, shifting each limb right by v3 bits and ORing in the carry produced from the low bits of the previous limb. Second pass walks the limbs descending, zeroing limbs below the whole-word shift (i < v8) and copying limbs down by v8 words otherwise. Returns the final assigned limb value.

operations.description: Decompose the shift: whole-word shift v8 = a2 / 32 and bit shift v3 = a2 % 32; seed the carry-in v11 to 0 and the limb countdown v10 to 3.

Bit-shift pass over the 3 limbs (countdown v10 from 3 to 1): for each limb extract the low v3 bits into v9, write (carry-in v11 | (unsigned)limb >> v3), and propagate the extracted bits left-shifted by (32 - v3) into v11 as the carry for the next limb.
Carry extraction and propagation: v9 = ~(-1 << v3) & *v2 captures the low v3 bits being shifted out; v11 = v9 << (32 - v3) moves them into the next limb's high bits.
Whole-word shift pass over limb indices 2 down to 0: when the index is below v8 the limb is zeroed; otherwise the limb is replaced by the limb v8 words lower, a1[i] = a1[i - v8].
Zero the limbs covered entirely by the whole-word shift (i < v8).
Return result, the limb value assigned on the final (i = 0) iteration.
